String.description: JS string. Double quotes interpolate `#{}`; single quotes do not.

Number.description: JS double-precision number; no integer type.

Array.description: JS array. Range literals `[1..5]` and slices produce arrays.

Object.description: JS object. Literals may omit braces and use indentation.

Function.description: Created with `->` or the bound `=>`. Compiles to a JS function or arrow function respectively.

RegExp.description: JS regex. `///...///` allows whitespace and comments.

Date.description: Date and time representation with millisecond precision since Unix epoch

Error.description: Base error class for runtime exceptions and custom error types

Promise.description: Awaited with `await`, which makes the containing function async.

null.description: Explicit empty value, distinct from undefined but grouped by `?`.

undefined.description: Absent value. The existential operator `?` tests for null or undefined together.

Class.description: Compiles to an ES class; the body is executable code.
